title: Audiobox: Unified Audio Generation with Natural Language Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness by comparing the performance of a zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) task across male and female speaker prompts, specifically measuring content correctness via Word Error Rate (WER) and style similarity via cosine similarity of style embeddings.

Evaluating fairness by comparing the performance of a zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) task across 64 different accent groups (derived from country labels), measuring Word Error Rate (WER) and style similarity using cosine similarity of style embeddings.
